subject: Proposal: staggered-credit onboarding window for LaunchForge cohort
messages:
From: Sofia Montoya <sofiam@launchforge.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Cohort credits — stacking with sponsor grant?

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — the team was impressed by the latency benchmarking and the model catalog. We’re putting together our onboarding plan for the LaunchForge Summer cohort (starts July 12) and have a couple of asks on promotional credits/packaging that I wanted to confirm quickly: 

- Sponsor grant: one of our institutional sponsors offers a $20k infrastructure grant that specifically covers "cloud credits" for the cohort. Can Redwood’s onboarding promo credits be stacked on top of that grant, or are they mutually exclusive?
- Billing window: the cohort spans two billing months. Is it possible to split Redwood credits across months (e.g., $5k of promo credit applied the first month and $10k the second) without creating an invoice/usage mismatch?
- If stacking or split application is possible, what approvals or contract amendments are required?

We’re trying to finalize the mutual action plan by next Wed and would appreciate a short confirmation (or list of conditions) so we can share with our finance lead. I attached our program tiers doc for context.

Best,
Sofia Montoya
Director, LaunchForge Accelerator
sofiam@launchforge.io
(415) 555-0212

Attachment: program_tiers.pdf (pdf, 180KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Montoya <sofiam@launchforge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 12:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort credits — stacking with sponsor grant?

Hi Sofia — great to hear from you and glad the demo landed well. Short answers first, then a suggested path: 

- Stacking: We can make a one-time exception to allow promo credits to stack with a sponsor grant for accredited accelerator partners. This is not standard, but we do grant exceptions when there is a clear sponsor/partner relationship.
- Split billing window: We can apportion promo credit across billing periods by creating a tailored credit ledger for the account (example: $5k applied in July, $10k in August). That requires an amendment to the standard credit terms so accounting can reconcile usage and tax treatment.
- Approvals/contract: We’ll need a short amendment signed (DocuSign) specifying the credit amounts, expiration date (we recommend 90 days from cohort start), and a cap per account to avoid misuse. Finance will need the sponsor grant letter for audit traces.

Proposed operational guardrails (what I suggest we offer LaunchForge):
- Promo credit: $15k cohort credit (one-time) that stacks with sponsor grant up to $20k
- Billing window: split credit ledger so $5k is available Day 1, remaining $10k unlocked after 30 days
- Usage cap: per-tenant cap of $3k/day to avoid burst consumption that invalidates the business case
- Expiration: credits expire 90 days after cohort start unless otherwise agreed

If that sounds reasonable I’ll route to Contracts for a short amendment and to Finance for bookkeeping notes. I’m copying Ben and Marissa to confirm commercial comfort and to ensure we handle partner optics. I attached the internal pricing sheet for reference.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if it helps finalize.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.ai

Attachment: MVP_pricing_sheet.xlsx (xlsx, 95KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>

Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort credits — stacking with sponsor grant?

Marissa — quick internal note on Olga’s suggested exception. I pasted her plan below for context.

> Proposed operational guardrails:
> - Promo credit: $15k cohort credit (one-time) that stacks with sponsor grant up to $20k
> - Billing window: split credit ledger so $5k is available Day 1, remaining $10k unlocked after 30 days
> - Usage cap: per-tenant cap of $3k/day
> - Expiration: 90 days

My concern: stacking two pots of credits drives consumption without meaningful commitment to paid spend — we risk high trial burn and revenue leakage. Finance will push back unless we secure a minimum committed spend or conversion trigger (e.g., 60% of cohort tenants convert to paid within 120 days). Alternative: offer a 25% onboarding discount applied to the first 3 months instead of stacking — achieves partner goodwill but reduces the headache for accounting.

If we do approve stacking, I’d ask for the following contract-level mitigations:
- A conversion milestone (as above) written into the amendment
- Sponsor grant letter attached to the DocuSign bundle for audit purposes
- A clause preventing cross-account credit transfer

Thoughts? If you’re comfortable with Olga’s optics, I can scope this with Contracts and get a CLS review.

—Ben
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Approved: staggered cohort credit — next steps

Hi Sofia — good news: we’ve reviewed internally and can approve the exception with the following conditions (summary):

1) Promo stacking approved: LaunchForge may stack Redwood onboarding promo credit ($15k) with the sponsor grant (up to $20k) for the specified cohort only.
2) Billing split & ledger: Redwood will create a cohort-level credit ledger that releases $5k Day 1 and the remaining $10k after 30 days. Finance will reconcile per-account usage against that ledger.
3) Usage caps & anti-abuse: Per-tenant daily cap of $3k. Credit transfer between accounts within the cohort is prohibited.
4) Conversion milestone: LaunchForge agrees to provide a cohort conversion report at 120 days; if fewer than 60% of paying tenants convert, Redwood reserves the right to withhold future stacking exceptions until remediation. This is a one-time clause for this cohort only.
5) Documentation: We require sponsor grant confirmation (PDF) and a signed amendment. I’ve initiated a DocuSign amendment and attached the draft; please route to your finance/legal for signature. Link below.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/launchforge/amendment-LF-2027-009
Attachment: amendment_launchforge_docusign.pdf (pdf, 60KB)

Next steps for you:
- Share sponsor grant confirmation with finance@redwood.ai
- Approve and sign the DocuSign amendment by Jun 30 to ensure credits are in place for July 12 cohort start

Happy to jump on a quick call if your finance team wants to walk through the reconciliation flow. Thanks for partnering with Redwood — excited to support LaunchForge’s cohort.
